answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 33581 Country: India Title: A person who is secretary of a madrasa utilized madrasa money in his own business, Question: A person who is secretary of a madrasa utilized madrasa money in his own business, Later on he clarified that he paid back the money with interest. What does Shariah say about it? Answer ID: 33581 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1275/1275/M=1432) The money of madrasa is a trust with the secretary of the madrasa. It is breach of trust to use it in one's business and it is compound sin to return it with interest. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
